config.home:
Legacy implementation only. This folder holds its settings, agent history, and messages. A path here takes precedence over `FACADE_HOME` and the `~/.facade` default.

[Edit in facade.json](command:facade.openSettingsFile) to change YOLO, suggested names, and how CLIs start.
config.framework:
Controls which implementation runs your agents.

- `auto`: Use the Facade Code Framework. A window switches to it once no agent of the legacy implementation is still running on this computer. Running agents are never interrupted: when the last one has ended, Facade offers to reload the window.
- `off`: Use the legacy implementation. If the Facade Code Framework causes problems, select `off`, reload the window, and let us know in a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/y5ez3g/facadecode/issues).

In a remote window, the remote machine's setting applies.
config.home.pattern: The path must start with ~/ or be absolute.
